eventDetail.scope: TIPTEKNO annual conferences, organized since 2010, bring together users, medical device manufacturers, researchers, managers and public representatives working in the field of medical technologies. It aims to share the results of recent scientific research on the fields of biomedical engineering and clinical engineering, and propose solutions to problems in medical device and healthcare sectors.
